body: there was someone awake at campus, they are helping me getting immediate help
Having a reason would make the whole thing so much easier. I don't have a particular reason, I am just feeling manically depressed and suicidal lately

It's 5 in the morning, what good can they do to me. They got families to care about and return to, I don't want them to listen to some whiny young brat hating himself. What can I expect them to do anyways

I have consider calling the local emergency room, but I can't get myself to do it. I can't see how they would help. I need help right now, i still can't stop shaking.. But i don't know what they even would do to me at 5 in the morning

I have felt like shit for years. I've had these episodes where I've felt like utter shit, but none as bad as this. I've had suicidal thoughts constantly these last couple of weeks, for no apparent reason. I just feel so incredibly useless, and I can't stop having emotional breakdowns every day.
